answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded haven. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra vine buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The juniper is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal 1xx67.
